title: Low-Cost FDM Fabrication of an Age-Scaled Pediatric Upper-Limb Osteology TLM Kit: Slicer Infill Ablation and Build-Orientation Validation
description: Open-source parametric Blender 5.2 CAD pipeline, watertight pediatric upper-limb 5-bone STL/3MF models (5-year and 8-9-year wire-articulated classroom kits), OrcaSlicer 2.5.1 Creality K1 profiles, G-code infill ablation dataset, and print-orientation validation logs developed under Payir Health Initiatives (Payir Trust) for Teaching-Learning Materials (TLM) at Ideapattrai - Makerspace, Aarvam Learning Lab.
notes: Dual-licensed: code/scripts under MIT (LICENSE-CODE); STLs, 3MF, slicer profiles, datasets, and figures under CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
